  := do
  let m0 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.mul self.c0 rhs.c0
  let m1 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.mul self.c1 rhs.c1
  let c ← aspis_core.field.CM31.add self.c0 self.c1
  let c1 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.add rhs.c0 rhs.c1
  let m2 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.mul c c1
  let c2 ← aspis_core.field.mul_by_r m1
  let c3 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.add m0 c2
  let c4 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.sub m2 m0
  let c5 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.sub c4 m1
  ok { c0 := c3, c1 := c5 }

/-- [aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::QM31}::square]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-core/src/field.rs', lines 951:4-951:31
    Name pattern: [aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::QM31}::square]
    Visibility: public -/
@[rust_fun "aspis_core::field::{aspis_core::field::QM31}::square"]
def aspis_core.field.QM31.square
  (self : aspis_core.field.QM31) : Result aspis_core.field.QM31 := do
  let c0_square ← aspis_core.field.CM31.square self.c0
  let c1_square ← aspis_core.field.CM31.square self.c1
  let c ← aspis_core.field.mul_by_r c1_square
  let c1 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.add c0_square c
  let c2 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.mul self.c0 self.c1
  let c3 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.double c2
  ok { c0 := c1, c1 := c3 }

  (self : aspis_core.field.QM31) (rhs : aspis_core.field.M31) :
  Result aspis_core.field.QM31
  := do
  let c ← aspis_core.field.CM31.mul_m31 self.c0 rhs
  let c1 ← aspis_core.field.CM31.mul_m31 self.c1 rhs
  ok { c0 := c, c1 }

def aspis_core.state_only_hiding.cm31_mul_i
  (value : aspis_core.field.CM31) : Result aspis_core.field.CM31 := do
  let m ← aspis_core.field.M31.neg value.b
  aspis_core.field.CM31.new m value.a

/-- [aspis_core::state_only_hiding::cm31_mul_r]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-core/src/state_only_hiding.rs', lines 442:0-442:34
    Name pattern: [aspis_core::state_only_hiding::cm31_mul_r] -/
@[rust_fun "aspis_core::state_only_hiding::cm31_mul_r"]
def aspis_core.state_only_hiding.cm31_mul_r
  (value : aspis_core.field.CM31) : Result aspis_core.field.CM31 := do
  let m ← aspis_core.field.M31.double value.a
  let m1 ← aspis_core.field.M31.sub m value.b
  let m2 ← aspis_core.field.M31.double value.b
  let m3 ← aspis_core.field.M31.add value.a m2
  aspis_core.field.CM31.new m1 m3

/-- [aspis_core::state_only_hiding::mul_tower_basis]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-core/src/state_only_hiding.rs', lines 448:0-448:58
    Name pattern: [aspis_core::state_only_hiding::mul_tower_basis] -/
@[rust_fun "aspis_core::state_only_hiding::mul_tower_basis"]
def aspis_core.state_only_hiding.mul_tower_basis
  (value : aspis_core.field.QM31) (coordinate : Std.Usize) :
  Result aspis_core.field.QM31
  := do
  match coordinate.val with
  | 0 => ok value
  | 1 =>
    let c ← aspis_core.state_only_hiding.cm31_mul_i value.c0
    let c1 ← aspis_core.state_only_hiding.cm31_mul_i value.c1
    ok { c0 := c, c1 }
  | 2 =>
    let c ← aspis_core.state_only_hiding.cm31_mul_r value.c1
    ok { c0 := c, c1 := value.c0 }
  | 3 =>
    let c ← aspis_core.state_only_hiding.cm31_mul_r value.c1
    let c1 ← aspis_core.state_only_hiding.cm31_mul_i c
    let c2 ← aspis_core.state_only_hiding.cm31_mul_i value.c0
    ok { c0 := c1, c1 := c2 }
  | _ => fail panic

def aspis_core.state_only_hiding.selected_mask_linears_loop.body
  (point : Array aspis_core.field.QM31 10#usize)
  (iter : core.iter.adapters.rev.Rev (core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize))
  (suffix : aspis_core.field.QM31) (weighted : aspis_core.field.QM31) :
  Result (ControlFlow ((core.iter.adapters.rev.Rev (core.ops.range.Range
    Std.Usize)) × aspis_core.field.QM31 × aspis_core.field.QM31)

  := do
  let (o, iter1) ←
    core.iter.adapters.rev.Rev.Insts.CoreIterTraitsIteratorIterator.next
      (core.ops.range.Range.Insts.DoubleEndedIterator
      core.iter.range.StepUsize) iter
  match o with
  | none => ok (done (suffix, weighted))
  | some variable1 =>
    let q ← Array.index_usize point variable1
    let suffix1 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.add suffix q
    if variable1 != 0#usize
    then
      let weighted1 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.add weighted suffix1
      ok (cont (iter1, suffix1, weighted1))
    else ok (cont (iter1, suffix1, weighted))

def aspis_core.state_only_hiding.selected_mask_linears_loop
  (iter : core.iter.adapters.rev.Rev (core.ops.range.Range Std.Usize))

/-- [aspis_core::state_only_hiding::selected_mask_linears]:

@[rust_fun "aspis_core::state_only_hiding::selected_mask_linears"]
def aspis_core.state_only_hiding.selected_mask_linears
  (point : Array aspis_core.field.QM31 10#usize) :
  Result (aspis_core.field.QM31 × aspis_core.field.QM31)
  := do
  let iter ←
    core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.rev.trait_default
      (core.iter.traits.iterator.IteratorRange core.iter.range.StepUsize)
      (core.ops.range.Range.Insts.DoubleEndedIterator
      core.iter.range.StepUsize)
      {
        start := 0#usize,
        «end» :=
          aspis_core.state_only_hiding.STATE_ONLY_HIDING_SUMCHECK_ROUNDS
      }
  let (suffix, weighted) ←
    aspis_core.state_only_hiding.selected_mask_linears_loop iter point
      aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO aspis_core.field.QM31.ZERO
  let q ← aspis_core.field.QM31.mul_m31 suffix 3#u32
  let q1 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.mul_m31 weighted 22#u32
  let q2 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.add q q1
  let q3 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.mul_m31 suffix 275#u32
  let q4 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.mul_m31 weighted 150#u32
  let q5 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.add q3 q4
  ok (q2, q5)

/-- [aspis_core::state_only_hiding::mask_power_26]:
    Source: 'crates/aspis-core/src/state_only_hiding.rs', lines 520:0-520:37
    Name pattern: [aspis_core::state_only_hiding::mask_power_26] -/
@[rust_fun "aspis_core::state_only_hiding::mask_power_26"]
def aspis_core.state_only_hiding.mask_power_26
  (value : aspis_core.field.QM31) : Result aspis_core.field.QM31 := do
  let x2 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.square value
  let x4 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.square x2
  let x8 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.square x4
  let x16 ← aspis_core.field.QM31.square x8
  let q ← aspis_core.field.QM31.mul x16 x8
  aspis_core.field.QM31.mul q x2

end ProverRwP7Mask
